cat > /home/user/godot_project/scene_gen.gd <<'END'
extends SceneTree

func _initialize() -> void:
	_run()

func _run() -> void:
	var scene := Node2D.new()
	scene.name = "NavWorld"
	scene.set_script(load("res://scripts/nav_world.gd"))
	
	var region := NavigationRegion2D.new()
	region.name = "Region"
	region.enabled = true
	scene.add_child(region)
	region.owner = scene
	
	var agent := CharacterBody2D.new()
	agent.name = "Agent"
	agent.global_position = Vector2(80, 300)
	agent.set_script(load("res://scripts/nav_agent.gd"))
	scene.add_child(agent)
	agent.owner = scene
	
	var nav := NavigationAgent2D.new()
	nav.name = "NavigationAgent2D"
	nav.path_desired_distance = 10
	nav.target_desired_distance = 20
	agent.add_child(nav)
	nav.owner = scene
	
	var obs_container := Node2D.new()
	obs_container.name = "Obstacles"
	scene.add_child(obs_container)
	obs_container.owner = scene
	
	var o1 := NavigationObstacle2D.new()
	o1.name = "Obstacle1"
	o1.global_position = Vector2(400, 200)
	o1.vertices = PackedVector2Array([Vector2(-40,-40), Vector2(40,-40), Vector2(40,40), Vector2(-40,40)])
	obs_container.add_child(o1)
	o1.owner = scene
	
	var o2 := NavigationObstacle2D.new()
	o2.name = "Obstacle2"
	o2.global_position = Vector2(400, 400)
	o2.vertices = PackedVector2Array([Vector2(-40,-40), Vector2(40,-40), Vector2(40,40), Vector2(-40,40)])
	obs_container.add_child(o2)
	o2.owner = scene
	
	var goal := Marker2D.new()
	goal.name = "Goal"
	goal.global_position = Vector2(720, 300)
	scene.add_child(goal)
	goal.owner = scene
	
	var packed := PackedScene.new()
	packed.pack(scene)
	ResourceSaver.save(packed, "res://scenes/nav_world.tscn")
	print("Done")
	quit()
END

## Implementation

details

- `/home/user/godot_project/scripts/nav_agent.gd`: `CharacterBody2D` with
a `NavigationAgent2D` child. `set_destination` sets the target. `_physics_process
` waits for the navigation map's `map_get_iteration_id` to be non-zero (so
`get_next_path_position` isn't stale), then drives the agent toward the next path position with `move_

and_slide`. Exposes `reached` (bool) and `movement_speed` (float).
- `/home/user/god
ot_project/scripts/nav_world.gd`: Controller node that builds navigation via `NavigationServer2D.bake_from
_source_geometry_data`. `rebake_navigation` adds the 800×600 walkable rectangle as
a traversable outline and each `NavigationObstacle2D`'s local `vertices` transformed by `global_position` as an obstruction
outline. `move_obstacle(name, pos)` updates an obstacle's position and rebakes. `start_navigation

` tells the agent the goal.
- `/home/user/godot_project/scenes/nav_world.tscn`:
Packed scene with `NavWorld` root, a `NavigationRegion2D`, a `CharacterBody2D` `Agent` (with
`NavigationAgent2D`), a `Marker2D` `Goal` at (720, 300),

and an `Obstacles` node with two `NavigationObstacle2D` nodes.
